in_marathi.name: Sanchayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who gathers or collects
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanchayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sanchaya' meaning 'collection' or 'gathering'. In Hindu mythology, Sanchayan is associated with the god Ganesha, who is the deity of wisdom and the remover of obstacles. Sanchayan represents the power to accumulate knowledge and wisdom, and the ability to overcome challenges.
